headline: KIRK 🩸 MURDER SUSPECT 🧑‍⚖️ Pleads NOT GUILTY 🚫 as Judge GREENLIGHTS ☠️ Death Penalty TRIAL
text:
TYLER ROBINSON 🧔‍♂️ the 23-year-old 🧑 Utah 🏔️ man just STOOD 🧍 in Provo 🏛️ court on Tuesday 🗓️ wearing a grey suit 👔 and PLEADED 🚫 not guilty to the AGGRAVATED MURDER 🔪 of conservative activist Charlie Kirk 🗣️ while a judge cleared the path for a full-on DEATH PENALTY ☠️ trial that could end with the needle 💉!! Defence lawyers 🧑‍⚖️ tried HARD 💪 to yank the lethal injection 🧪 off the table but prosecutors fired back 🔥 saying shooting into a crowd 👥 full of CHILDREN 🧒 at a campus event 🏫 on 10 September 2025 📅 counts as aggravating factors that totally warrant capital punishment ⚖️!! Kirk the Turning Point USA 🍔 co-founder was only 31 🧔 when he got shot 🩸 in the neck while speaking at Utah Valley University and his widow Erika 👰 along with parents Robert and Kathryn sat right there in the gallery watching every second 👀 of this tense hearing that felt like edging 😩 toward justice!!

The Kirk family dropped a statement afterwards 📝 saying the judge's decision marks an important step in their pursuit of justice ⚖️ and every single step in this process carries the heavy weight of all that Charlie's murder has taken especially from his two little kids 👦👧 who will now grow up without their father 😢!! Prosecutor Ryan McBride stood up and laid out a literal MOUNTAIN 🏔️ of evidence including DNA 🧬 tying Robinson to the murder weapon 🔫 plus confessions he allegedly made to loved ones ❤️ and a taped video statement from his roommate and romantic partner Lance Twiggs 🎥 that straight up cooked him 🔥!! McBride listed it off one two three four like 1️⃣ video evidence of Robinson dressed to kill 👔 on campus that day 2️⃣ the DNA match 3️⃣ his own admissions and 4️⃣ all the circumstantial clues that prove he is the shooter no doubt 🕵️!!

Prosecutors also spilled that the former apprentice electrician ⚡ was in a relationship with his roommate 🛏️ and viewed Kirk's conservative views especially on transgender issues as totally repugnant 🤢 which they argued was the twisted motive that made him pull the trigger 🔫 after scouting the campus multiple times that day interacting with TPUSA members then eating Chick-fil-A 🍔 before changing into long pants to hide the rifle down his pants 🩳!! They called it gambling with the lives of others by firing toward Kirk who was surrounded by people playing a sick game of ballistic roulette 🎰 and prosecutor Chad Grunander reminded everyone it's been 356 days 📆 since Tyler Robinson assassinated Charlie Kirk and now it's time to bind him over for trial today 🏛️!!

Defence team tried their best to sow doubt 🌱 about the prosecution's evidence during the five-day preliminary hearing in July questioning procedures and the credentials of experts while repeatedly objecting to cameras livestreaming the court proceedings 📹 but Judge Tony Graf listened to arguments in a sealed hearing then ruled for transparency anyway because this case has already sparked wild conspiracy theories 🕵️‍♂️!! On Tuesday they also downplayed the aggravating factors claiming no bullets hit anyone in the crowd except Kirk so maybe it's not that serious after all 🙄 yet the judge still gave the green light for prosecutors to seek the ultimate penalty ☠️ in what is shaping up to be an absolute marathon trial that will have everyone glued to their screens 📺!!

During that July hearing the court saw how the accused allegedly scouted the campus repeatedly interacting with folks then munching Chick-fil-A 🍟 before returning in different clothes with the rifle concealed and his DNA 🧬 was found on grandpa's rifle 🔫 stashed in a wooded area near campus plus on the towel it was wrapped in and a screwdriver 🛠️ recovered at the scene!! McBride also pointed out engravings on the casings from the shooting matched a Dremel tool found at the home he shared with roommate Lance Twiggs and that videotaped interview showed Twiggs saying Robinson confessed cried 😭 and said he wished he hadn't done it right before turning himself in the next day with family and a neighbour by his side 👨‍👩‍👧!! Robinson is next due back in court on 23 October when a trial date gets set and the whole thing feels like the system is finally about to rail this case all the way to its climax with the possibility of lethal injection waiting at the end 🪦!!
